title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
天海市。某情侣宾馆。“昨晚，你爽够了吗？”“额……还挺舒服。”啪——暧昧氛围灯下，情趣大床上一位赤身裸体、样貌帅气的青年，被狠狠抽了一巴掌。“你倒是爽够了，那我呢？”冷希眼眶泛红，泪光闪烁，眼中满是羞怒之色。明川捂着脸，一脸委屈：“不是，美女，昨晚也不是我一个人爽啊，再说了，我哪知道你是第一次啊，我看你叫的挺大声……”“住嘴！”冷希俏脸羞红，恶狠狠地出声打断。此时的她，简直想杀人的心都有了。身为堂堂冷氏集团董事长，她居然被人下药，莫名其妙把身子交给了一个陌生男人，更重要的是……还是在这种接头随处可见的小宾馆。这件事情要是传出去，足够她身败名裂了！明川也很无语，毕竟下山前师父们就告诉过他，城里的女人都坏得很，现在看来果然没错，明明昨晚那么热情火辣，结果醒来就跟变了个人似的，冷若冰霜。早知道这样，昨晚办完事，自己就该提裤子走人。“转过去！”“又怎么了？”“我……穿衣服！”冷希俏脸羞红，目光却仿佛能活吞了明川。“哦……”明川不情愿照做。只听背后一阵窸窸窣窣的声响，半晌后再次开口：“行了，转过来吧。”明川回头，此时的冷希已经穿戴整齐，原本白皙诱人的酮体，此刻被一件勾勒腰身的职业套装遮掩，黑丝包裹着修长的美腿，搭配上那清冷精致的面容，妥妥的冰山美人。“这里是一百万，拿了钱，出去后给我把今天的事情烂在肚子里，不能对外提半个字，我们就当从来没见过。”一百万，打发叫花子呢？都不提自己马上要继承大师姐那市值千亿的万盛国际集团，光是下山时候，师父们给他的路费，都有好几百亿呢。明川嘴角一撇，不管转念一想，自己除了挨了一巴掌，好像也没吃亏，一百万就一百万吧。咚咚咚——

“屋里的狗男女，给我滚出来！”就在这时，房门忽然被人敲响，并且传来了极为难听的叫骂声。明川脸色大变，这该不会就是三师父口中的仙人跳吧？可抬头一看，那女人的脸色比她更加难看，甚至美眸中还闪过了一丝慌乱。该不会是来捉奸的吧？明川问道：“外面的人你认识？”“是我妹妹。”冷希自嘲一笑，带着几分苦涩。此时的她，已经大概猜到了，能给自己下药的除非亲近信任之人，偏偏这么巧，自己刚被下药，后脚她就带人找上们来了。“哦，那她还骂这么难听？跟你有仇啊？”明川笑了，一副看热闹不嫌事大的模样。“你给我闭嘴！”冷希深吸一口气，仿佛做出了什么决定般，美眸直勾勾盯着明川：“记住，待会他们冲进来，你就说你是我新交的男朋友，不要提昨晚下药的事情，一口咬定是我们就是情侣关系。”“为什么啊？”“有人算计我，想让我身败名裂，交出冷氏集团大权，我岂会让她如意！”冷希贝齿紧咬，眼中满是怒意。“啊这……”“美女，不是我不帮你，主要是咱们之间压根都不熟悉，别人随便问两句，咱们就不露馅了吗？”明川耸了耸肩。“我叫冷希，冷氏集团董事长，冷家大小姐，海归双学位博士，单身至今，无任何不良嗜好，身材各方面，你昨晚不都自己体验过吗！”冷希咬牙切齿地看着明川，意思是现在可以了吧？可岂料。明川闻言，眉头一皱：“你说你叫什么？”“冷希，怎么有问题吗？”“没什么，只是我未婚妻也叫冷希。”明川如实说道，下山前师傅们一人给了他一份婚书，其中四师傅给他的那份，上面写的就是这个名字。冷希闻言倏然笑了起来，没想到这家伙看着呆头呆脑的，还挺上道。“行！未婚妻也行，就说咱们已经私下订过婚，这样她就更挑不出把柄来了。”“不是，我的意思是，你真是我未婚妻啊！”明川无奈解释道。“对！待会就是这种状态，保持住！”冷希拍了拍明川的脸颊，一副非常满意的样子，“我看好你，只要你好好表现，事成之后给你加钱！”

Tianhai City.A couple hotel."Did you feel good enough last night?" "Well... it's quite comfortable." Pah - Under the ambiguous atmosphere light, a naked, handsome young man on the big erotic bed was slapped hard."You are happy enough, what about me?" Leng hope's eyes were red, tears were shining, and his eyes were full of shame and anger.Mingchuan covered his face with an aggrieved look on his face: "No, beauty, I wasn't the only one who had fun last night. Besides, I didn't know it was your first time. I saw you screamed quite loudly..." "Shut up!" Leng Xi blushed and interrupted fiercely.At this moment, she almost wanted to kill someone.As the chairman of the Tangtang Leng Group, she was actually drugged and handed over her body to a strange man for no apparent reason. More importantly...it was in a small hotel where such joints can be seen everywhere.If this matter spreads, it will ruin her reputation!Mingchuan was also speechless. After all, his masters told him before going down the mountain that the women in the city were very bad. Now it seemed that it was true. He was so passionate and hot last night, but when he woke up, he felt like a different person, as cold as ice.If I had known this, I should have picked up my pants and left after finishing the work last night."Turn around!" "What's wrong?" "I...get dressed!" Leng hope's face turned red with embarrassment, but her eyes seemed to swallow Mingchuan alive."Oh..." Mingchuan reluctantly complied.He only heard a rustling sound behind him, and after a while he said again: "Okay, turn around." Mingchuan turned around, and Leng Xi was fully dressed at this time. Her originally fair and attractive body was now covered by a business suit that outlined her waist. Black silk wrapped her slender legs, and paired with her cold and delicate face, she looked like an iceberg beauty."Here is one million. Take the money. When you go out, keep today's affairs in your stomach. Don't mention a word to the outside world. We will pretend we have never met." One million, how about sending a beggar away?Not even mentioning that he was about to inherit his senior sister's Wansheng International Group with a market value of hundreds of billions, the traveling expenses his masters gave him were tens of billions just when he went down the mountain.Mingchuan curled his lips, and no matter what he thought about it, he didn't seem to suffer any loss except for being slapped. One million is just one million.Dong dong dong——

"You bitch man and woman in the house, get out of here!" At this moment, someone suddenly knocked on the door, and an extremely unpleasant yelling sound came from the room.Mingchuan's face changed drastically. Could this be the immortal dance mentioned by the third master?But when she looked up, the woman's face was even uglier than hers, and there was even a hint of panic in her beautiful eyes.Are you here to catch an adulterer?Mingchuan asked, "Do you know the people outside?" "It's my sister." Leng hope laughed at himself, with a bit of bitterness.At this time, she had roughly guessed that the only person who could drug her was someone close to her and whom she trusted. It happened to be such a coincidence that she had just been drugged, and she led someone to find them."Oh, then she still scolds you so harshly? Does she have a grudge against you?" Mingchuan smiled, looking like he was just watching the fun and not taking it too seriously."Shut up!" Leng Xi took a deep breath, as if he had made a decision, and stared straight at Mingchuan with her beautiful eyes: "Remember, when they rush in later, you will say that you are my new boyfriend. Don't mention the drugging thing last night, and insist that we are a couple." "Why?" "Someone is plotting against me and wants me to be ruined and hand over the power of the Leng Group. How can I let her get what she wants!" Leng Xi gritted her teeth, her eyes full of anger."Ah, this..." "Beauty, it's not that I won't help you, it's mainly because we are not familiar with each other at all. If others just ask a few questions, we won't reveal the truth?" Mingchuan shrugged."My name is Leng Xi, the chairman of the Leng Group, the eldest lady of the Leng family, a double-degree doctorate returned from overseas. I am single now, without any bad habits, and I have experienced all aspects of my figure last night, didn't you?" Leng hope gritted his teeth and looked at Mingchuan, meaning it's okay now, right?Unexpectedly.Mingchuan frowned when he heard this: "What did you say your name was?" "Leng hope, what's the problem?" "Nothing, it's just that my fiancée is also named Leng Xi." Mingchuan said truthfully. Before going down the mountain, each of the masters gave him a marriage certificate, and the one the four masters gave him had this name written on it.Leng hope suddenly laughed when he heard this. Unexpectedly, this guy looked so stupid, but he was quite polite."Okay! Fiancée is fine too, just say that we are already privately engaged, so she won't be able to find fault." "No, I mean, you are really my fiancee!" Mingchuan explained helplessly."Yes! This will be the state for a while, keep it up!" Leng Xi patted Mingchuan's cheek, looking very satisfied, "I'm optimistic about you. As long as you perform well, I'll give you more money when the job is done!"
